MacroName wizard_summary

##################DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING IN THIS SCRIPT!#############
# Name: wizard_summary
# Author: Simon Fromm
# Version: 1.0
# SerialEM version: 4.2.X or higher
# Last update: 22.04.2026
# Support: simon.fromm@embl.de
# DOES NOT WORK AS STANDALONE. Needs to be called via the LowDoseWizard script
###################################################################

#################################################
# Write settings into summary file
#################################################

IsVariableDefined c2R
If $repVal1 == 0
   SkipTo Finish
Endif

IsVariableDefined fluenceR
If $repVal1 == 0
   SkipTo Finish
Endif

If $EnergyFilter == 1
   imagingmode = EFTEM
Else
   imagingmode = TEM
Endif

If $probeR == 0
   probemode = nanoProbe
Else
   probemode = microProbe
Endif

ReportDateTime
date = $repVal1
OpenTextFile LDW O 0 LowDoseWizard_summary.txt
WriteLineToFile LDW $InstituteA $InstituteB, $date
WriteLineToFile LDW $Tem_model $Tem_special (aka '$Tem_name')
WriteLineToFile LDW $EnergyFilter_model $Detector_model
WriteLineToFile LDW Operating voltage = $Acc_volt kV
WriteLineToFile LDW Cs = $Cs mm
WriteLineToFile LDW C2 aperture = $c2apR microns
IsVariableDefined objap
If $repVal1 == 1
   If $objap != 0
      WriteLineToFile LDW Objective aperture = $objap microns
   Else
      WriteLineToFile LDW No objective aperture inserted.
   Endif
Else
   WriteLineToFile LDW No objective aperture inserted.
Endif
WriteLineToFile LDW
If $CondenserConfig == 2
   If $EnergyFilter == 1
      WriteLineToFile LDW Record: $mag_R kx ($pixR A/px), $fluenceR e-/A^2 fluence, $timeR-round s exposure, $fluxP-round e/px/s flux over empty area, Counting mode, spot $spR $probemode, $imagingmode $wR eV slit width
   Else
      WriteLineToFile LDW Record: $mag_R kx ($pixR A/px), $fluenceR e-/A^2 fluence, $timeR-round s exposure, $fluxP-round e/px/s flux over empty area, Counting mode, spot $spR $probemode, $imagingmode
   Endif
Elseif $CondenserConfig == 3
   If $EnergyFilter == 1
      WriteLineToFile LDW Record: $mag_R kx ($pixR A/px), $fluenceR e-/A^2 fluence, $timeR-round s exposure, $fluxP-round e/px/s flux over empty area, Counting mode, spot $spR $probemode, $imagingmode $wR eV slit width, Beam size $c2R um
   Else
      WriteLineToFile LDW Record: $mag_R kx ($pixR A/px), $fluenceR e-/A^2 fluence, $timeR-round s exposure, $fluxP-round e/px/s flux over empty area, Counting mode, spot $spR $probemode, $imagingmode, Beam size $c2R um
   Endif
Endif

Echo
Echo A LowDoseWizard summary file (LowDoseWizard_summary.txt) containing all relevant parameters for image processing has been saved into the current SerialEM working directory.
Echo

Finish:
